sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2023 Porsche 911 GT3, finished in Gentian Blue Metallic with a black interior. This 911 GT3 is equipped with the desirable 6-speed manual transmission, and the odometer currently displays approximately 4,700 miles. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this GT3’s past. It also confirms that this is a one-owner car. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, notable factory equipment includes 20-inch front and 21-inch rear center-lock wheels, Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes (PCCB), a front-axle lift system, an extended-range fuel tank, Exclusive Design taillights, leather and Race-Tex upholstery, 18-way power-adjustable heated Adaptive Sport front seats, and a Bose surround sound system. The seller reports no notable modifications. With the 992 generation of the iconic 911 GT3, Porsche managed an impressive feat – further improving one of the most rewarding track-focused sports cars on the market. Highlights include the adoption of a double wishbone setup for the front suspension (a feature previously reserved for 911 race cars), a completely redesigned aero package for up to 150% more downforce compared to its predecessor, and a range of clever weight-saving measures to keep the GT3 as light as possible. A glorious, naturally aspirated 4.0-liter engine is the cherry on top. Power comes from a 4.0-liter flat-6, rated at 502 horsepower and 346 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 6-speed manual transmission.
